# Chartroom

Chartroom is the central engineering knowledge base for the Robots project by Philip McGaw.

## Purpose

Chartroom records cross-project engineering knowledge: system architecture, communications, engineering decisions, development guidance, simulation and test, ROS 2/Gazebo course material, tutorials, and the overall roadmap.

## Repository boundaries

- Chartroom — cross-project engineering architecture, rationale, decisions, reusable guidance, and roadmap.
- CuttleOS — robot-side software implementation, including Cockpit, Control, and DataLogger.
- SquidLink — ROS 2/Gazebo simulation and SiL/HiL integration testing.
- NautiPi — physical hardware, electronics, PCBs, embedded projects, and hardware reference material.

## Authority

Chartroom is authoritative for cross-project architecture, engineering rationale, significant decisions, reusable guidance, and the overall roadmap.
CuttleOS is authoritative for robot-side software implementation.
SquidLink is authoritative for simulation and simulation-side integration testing.
NautiPi is authoritative for physical hardware design.
